agents.name: claude-code
agents.role: General-purpose coding agent on the claude-code harness; dispatchable on a fresh install.

agents.name: healer
agents.role: Closed-loop repair agent — diagnoses production alerts and opens a fresh fix branch + PR.

agents.name: implementer
agents.role: Unattended agent that builds one ticket and commits it on the run branch.

agents.name: planner
agents.role: Interactive planning agent that turns a finalized intent into a structured seeds plan.

agents.name: pr-fixer
agents.role: CI-repair agent — fixes failing checks on warren-opened PRs directly on the PR branch.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.role: Unattended agent that reviews a factory PR cold against its ticket and reports a verdict.

agents.name: rework
agents.role: Unattended agent that fixes the findings of an automated review on the PR branch.
